reasons.correctness: Repository finder, service method and CronJob follow the interface exactly. Properties and defaults are right, the disabled path does nothing, failures are caught and logged. Build green, hidden tests 4/4, existing tests 55/55.
reasons.convention_fit: StaleTicketCloseCronJob has @SchedulerLock 'support:staleTicketClose', cron and enabled flag from properties, @RequiredArgsConstructor and the CronJob suffix. Code sits in the support/ticket feature package. New *UnitTest classes use MockitoExtension with no Spring context and were run.
reasons.design_fit: Logic sits in SupportTicketService and the query is a derived repository method. The job only delegates. Minor smells: per-ticket save in the loop, and two 'completed' log lines in closeStaleTickets.
reasons.test_quality: Service tests cover closing multiple tickets and the empty case. Cron tests cover enabled, disabled and exception-swallowed. The cutoff is matched with any(LocalDateTime), so the days-to-cutoff computation is unpinned. LENIENT strictness is also set.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket files and the existing *CronJob classes. The agent then read NoConsentAccountCleanupCronJob and the target files before editing. Test files and properties were found with find and grep, not the graph.
